units.source_text: 走过独木桥之前，宪兵回头打了个手势，让一行人止步。

en.t: Before crossing the log bridge, the military policeman turned back and made a gesture, signaling the group to stop.

units.source_text: 据说从前这里有座出自运庆、湛庆②所建的仁王门。

en.t: It is said that in earlier times there stood here a Niomon gate built by Unkei and Tankei.②

units.source_text: 从这里再往里走，九十九谷的群山都成了金刚院的领地。

en.t: From here, as one went farther in, all the mountains of Tsukumo Valley became the domain of Kongo-in.
